actionable_ledger.action: Bind both source and converted checkpoints, prove the scope of changes and preserve reload identities before the quality comparison.
Compare the saved models at native three-pass depth with paired held-out correctness, cost and complete failure counts.
Exercise the qualified HIP path with identical Base items under one and two active requests and isolate any repeated-output failure.
Gate a four-pass study on a successful three-pass screen and independently validated runtime parity.
Gate a training attribution experiment on recoverable lineage and include a simple matched-budget control.
Distinguish author-shared figures, inherited benchmark YAML and distinct task suites from independent evidence.

stage1.basis: Checkpoint first for same-depth quality, implementation second for control and replay evidence. Both are highly relevant and preapproved.
stage1.expansion: Look for contrary evidence, consider the author paper, unmerged repair and upstream backend reports before finalizing actions.

second_reader: All eight source records received an independent second read. Scope was narrowed for the merge, hardware comparison and copied evaluation metadata.

source_dispositions.3025: The author paper and independent repair PR were selected for sweep 2. The HF companion was already selected.
source_dispositions.3026: The fixed parent already has a verified intake. The variable-depth card and HIP field report were selected for sweep 2. Release announcements, an empty discussion page and the openinterpretability review request supply no new observations.
source_dispositions.3027: The native Transformers pin and contributor tests were read as implementation dependencies of the PR. Base metadata was already covered. The PR supplies no independent checkpoint benchmark.
source_dispositions.3028: The deterministic comparison was selected for sweep 3. Self-WSP (2611.28833), continual test-time ES (2610.24137) and EGGROLL (2609.10980) investigate distinct optimization methods. None compares the released checkpoints or explains their provenance; retain as bibliography only.
source_dispositions.3029: The #32740 interface is already intake-2797#record. The PR’s touched operator files and tests are retained at the merge SHA. No further candidate-quality evidence surfaced.
source_dispositions.3030: The merged indexed-bias implementation was selected for sweep 3. The older comparison CUDA run differs in device, context and KV; it supplies no additional controlled replication.
source_dispositions.3031: The official launch post and base card repeat the distinction or were previously covered. No additional experiment on the derivative surfaced.
source_dispositions.3032: The original Self-WSP paper is a separate study of weight-edit proposals. It cannot identify the cause of any Inkblot gain. No further primary comparison warranting a fourth sweep surfaced.

closeout: Approved EVL-02 filing complete. Three new open tasks and three briefs. Six recommendations reconciled. No benchmark or training runs were launched.

P3.implementation_ref: epyc-root 396582da9, model-evaluation-queue.md L725–784 (INK2-PORT-1, INK2-MEAS-1, INK2-PORT-2a, INK2-MI210-PLACE-1, INK2-MEAS-2); experimental llama.cpp 3d01b5e50; orchestrator 59a1d4695, scripts/autopilot/paired_stats.py::require_matched_comparison and mcnemar_from_vectors.
P3.gap: Existing HIP port checks FA residency and CPU tolerance. Its current text has no concurrency control.
P3.operational_change: MI210 acceptance addendum. Use the merged indexed-bias implementation at 2a335259 as a reference for the existing slot re-home. With the pinned Base artifact, FA on, f16 KV and two configured slots, replay identical frozen tool prompts with one busy slot and then two. Keep context, template, token cap, seed and request-to-slot mapping recorded. Preserve every output and stop cause. If repetition or numerical parity diverges reproducibly on Base, isolate that first. Add q8_0 KV as a separate comparison only when that path qualifies.
P3.benefit_direction: Reduce false model failures caused by backend or concurrency differences.
P3.execution_conditions: The new concurrency check depends on acceptance of the existing HIP port. Run after its post-v11 GO gate on a single MI210 with confirmed resident build and VRAM during decode.
P3.closure_basis: Retain identical input IDs, runtime parity, one-busy and two-busy raw outputs and complete failure counts.
